scenarios.name: Minimize while a panel context menu is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the display control is configured to toggle between the full ribbon and compact group buttons
the user right-clicks the Modify panel title
the user clicks the ribbon display control
the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons
the user clicks the ribbon display control again
